Strait of Hormuz Shipping Traffic Drops Amid Regional Tensions

Shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has fallen to a one-week low, with only six vessels observed transiting the vital waterway. This decline coincides with ongoing hostilities in the region, prompting Gulf states to explore alternative shipping routes. International wire coverage highlights concerns about global oil stockpiles and the potential impact of a US-Iran conflict on oil exports and regional stability, particularly affecting Iraq's funding. Iran has also contested US claims of "total control" over the Strait.
